easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Sceptre of Eternal Glory to become a creature.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Sceptre of Eternal Glory, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
